newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cultus says writedowns hit results.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cultus says writedowns hit results.

text.p: Oil and gas producer Cultus Petroleum Ltd said a write-down of exploration expenditure of A$14.5 million was the main reason it fell into a loss in the year to June 30.
Cultus said a further A$0.8 million was charged in restructuring GFE Resources Ltd after its purchase last year.
It said successful exploration drilling in the onshore Otway Basin in Victoria had set the scene for further discoveries and increased production in the near future.
Appraisal and development of the new Skull Creek gas field is planned for the 1996/97 financial year.
Cultus earlier reported a A$4.64 million net loss for 1995/96 against a profit of A$12.46 million in 1994/95.
At 12.40 p.m. (0240 GMT), Cultus shares were one cent lower at 76 cents.
